title: Microsoft Edge: v.144 - Tenant Restrictions v2 (TRv2)
description: New enforcement to block access from unauthorized Microsoft 365 tenants directly in Microsoft Edge for Business, helping organizations maintain strict compliance and prevent data leakage across tenant boundaries.
